description: Defines functions, structures, and constants for querying and translating OpenGL image formats to native formats within the ANGLE project, specifically for the GL renderer.

classes.name: SupportRequirement
classes.description: Represents the support requirements for a specific GL format, including version and extension dependencies.

classes.name: InternalFormat
classes.description: Encapsulates support requirements for various internal formats, including texture, filter, attachment, and renderbuffer support.

classes.name: TexImageFormat
classes.description: Holds information about a texture image format, including internal format, format, and type.

classes.name: TexSubImageFormat
classes.description: Holds format and type information for sub-image texture updates.

classes.name: CompressedTexImageFormat
classes.description: Contains internal format info for compressed textures.

classes.name: CompressedTexSubImageFormat
classes.description: Contains format info for compressed sub-image textures.

classes.name: CopyTexImageImageFormat
classes.description: Contains internal format info for copied texture images.

classes.name: TexStorageFormat
classes.description: Holds internal format info for texture storage.

classes.name: RenderbufferFormat
classes.description: Holds internal format info for renderbuffers.

classes.name: ReadPixelsFormat
classes.description: Contains format and type info for reading pixels from framebuffer.

methods.name: GetInternalFormatInfo
methods.description: Retrieves internal format support info based on GLenum internalFormat and standard.

methods.name: GetTexImageFormat
methods.description: Determines the appropriate TexImageFormat based on provided parameters and features.

methods.name: GetTexSubImageFormat
methods.description: Determines the appropriate TexSubImageFormat based on provided parameters and features.

methods.name: GetCompressedTexImageFormat
methods.description: Retrieves support info for compressed texture images.

methods.name: GetCompressedSubTexImageFormat
methods.description: Retrieves support info for compressed sub-image textures.

methods.name: GetCopyTexImageImageFormat
methods.description: Retrieves support info for copied texture images.

methods.name: GetTexStorageFormat
methods.description: Retrieves support info for texture storage formats.

methods.name: GetRenderbufferFormat
methods.description: Retrieves support info for renderbuffer formats.

methods.name: GetReadPixelsFormat
methods.description: Retrieves format and type info for reading pixels.
